title: Rafael and the Signal
author: Freya Galloway
blurb: Wren Zhou, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
